title: ByteDance's Seedream 5.5 Officially Launches on Doubao: Image Design Capabilities Receive a Comprehensive Upgrade

content_html:
On November 10, ByteDance's popular AI app "Doubao" received an important feature update. The company announced that its image design capabilities have been fully upgraded and now officially integrate the previously released next-generation image creation model, Seedream5.5. This integration will bring users a more professional and efficient visual generation and editing experience.

Three core features fully launched, completely breaking through the pain points of traditional AI image generation

By introducing the Seedream5.5 model, Doubao has achieved multi-dimensional technological breakthroughs in image creation and post-processing:

Stable continuous editing for up to 100 rounds: When traditional models make local edits to generated images, they often suffer from overall style drift or degraded image quality. The new model, through specialized training, achieves pixel-level preservation of non-edited areas, allowing users to make up to 100 rounds of continuous modifications around the same artwork, making the creative refinement process smoother.

Native RGBA transparent assets generated directly: The model can directly generate transparent or semi-transparent images with an Alpha channel, and handles complex edges and transparent areas with fine detail. This feature completely eliminates tedious post-processing cutouts and edge cleanup, making it convenient to use generated images as independent assets directly in subsequent design layouts.

Dual improvements in image quality and text rendering: In terms of visual texture, the new model effectively improves lighting, materials, and skin texture, reducing overly glossy or overexposed effects, resulting in more natural and realistic image quality. At the same time, it significantly improves text rendering, restoring complex glyphs and dense small text more accurately.

With the official integration of Seedream5.5, Doubao's practicality in visual generation and lightweight design scenarios has been further enhanced, providing creators and ordinary users with a more reliable AI-assisted design tool.
